analysisScope: Completed immutable reports only; no measurement, build, source or protocol edits
populationDefinition: All 20 registered seeds; null sorts after reached; index floor((N-1)*q). Worst is null when any seed is censored.
conditionalDefinition: Reached observations only; same lower-index quantile convention. Unreached retained in denominator.
units: seconds unless explicitly named minutes; bigint damage and power preserved as decimal strings; derived2h–12h event gaps subtract integer100ms ticks before returning decimal seconds

validation.checks: Independent raw/manifest/file hash checks; archived source/evaluator/build digests; 20 canonical seeds; record/checkpoint consistency; conditional summaries and population target recomputation

selection.rule: Screening: population firstAccepted p50 2700..3600sec and >=18/20 by5400sec. Full12h: both plus population h70 eligibility p50 28800..43200sec. Rank by abs(first p50-3150), abs(final p50-36000), population first p90, ID.
selection.exactArithmetic: Distances and ordering recomputed from integer100ms ticks, then expressed in seconds. The immutable snapshot retains its original JS floating-point tuple display; ordering and source results are unchanged.

interpretation.basis: All8 experiments have endedAt. Artifact integrity is PASS for11reports/220raw. All three candidates pass first goals and exact recorded prefix pairing. 10425 fails h70 lower bound; 10450 and10475 pass both goals. Their first-distance247.4sec and firstp904527.5sec tie; 10475 final-distance1946sec beats10450 distance6096.5sec under the preregistered rule.

selectedCandidateLimits.note: The preregistered population median criterion passes despite substantial tail nonarrival. Conditional success times, coverage and actual rare choices remain separate; no new final90% threshold or alternative selection criterion is invented.

interpretation.preservedFailures: All five controls fail screening; their12h objective is NOT_EVALUATED. Candidate10425 completes12h but fails h70 lower bound. Previous rounds and all intermediate snapshots remain immutable.
interpretation.lateActivity: Every candidate has positive same-seed8h-to12h kill gains and later reincarnation actions in20/20 seeds. New acquisition gaps and repeated actions are separate; some slow seeds continue progressing with long combat gaps while faster seeds exhaust the standard catalogue.
interpretation.nextAction: Host may record official adoption of the exact20 parameters/content IDs and then execute untouched validation seeds1–100 for12h. This analysis does not change protocol/source or tune on validation seeds. The adopted source still requires its registered AC and exact gates; release proof is later on version0.7.0.
interpretation.releaseBoundary: Exploration analysis and candidate recommendation only, not candidate validation, result audit completion or release verification. Native firstReady minor must be repaired and freshly checked before final natural observation. humanChecks=PENDING.
